text: Minor degree requirement profile for Physics Minor Undergraduate Program (PHYS-MINOR), admit/curriculum term Fall 2023-2024 (202301). Total minimum SU credits: 18. Total minimum ECTS: None. Sections: required courses (12 SU, 7 courses in pool), core electives (6 SU, 46 courses in pool). Diploma area advisors: İnanç Adagideli.

The required courses pool for the Physics Minor Undergraduate Program (PHYS-MINOR), admit/curriculum term Fall 2023-2024 (202301) contains 7 courses; minimum 12 SU credits required. Courses: ENS 201 Electromagnetics I, PHYS 302 Solid State Physics, PHYS 303 Quantum Mechanics I, PHYS 304 Quantum Mechanics II, PHYS 401 Classical Mechanics, PHYS 411 Electromagnetic Theory I, PHYS 412 Statistical Mechanics. PHYS 303, PHYS 304 and 2 courses among ENS 201 or PHYS 411, PHYS 412, PHYS 401, PHYS 302. The extra courses taken from this pool, are directly counted towards "Core Elective” course requirements.
